# debian/sway/packages.txt - the sway desktop, on top of
# debian/common/packages.txt. Only what is needed and proven on the tablet.
#
# Compositor, wallpaper, idle handling, terminal, launcher
sway
swaybg
swayidle
foot
fuzzel
# GPU: Mesa with the Panfrost driver
libgl1-mesa-dri
libegl1
libgles2
# Fonts
fonts-dejavu-core
fonts-terminus-otb
# Screen rotation from the accelerometer (autorotate.sh)
iio-sensor-proxy
# Image viewer (its command is imv-wayland; plain imv is renameutils)
imv
# "Open with" for programs and links (xdg-open, ~/.config/mimeapps.list)
xdg-utils
